title: About
text:
Here’s a little history about me!
I am originally from outside of Ottawa, ON, which is the traditional and unceded territories of the Omàmìwininìwag (Algonquin) and Anishinabewaki ᐊᓂᔑᓈᐯᐗᑭ.

title: Kelsey McGuire
text: Hello and thank you for visiting my website! My name is Kelsey McGuire and I am currently a second-year masters student at the University of British Columbia with the Boreal-Arctic Biogeochemistry Lab. I am being supervised by Dr. McKenzie Kuhn, where my MSc thesis seeks to understand how vegetation along a Kaska lake shoreline alters methane (CH4) emission directly and indirectly. I would like to acknowledge that I am a visitor that lives and conducts research on the traditional, ancestral, and unceded territories of the xʷməθkwəy̓əm Musqueam, Skwxwú7mesh Squamish, and səlilwətaɬ/Selilwitulh Tsleil-Waututh nations. The research towards my current thesis has been conducted in partnership with the Kaska Dena Kayeh peoples and I have been thankful to work on their land and to learn from their land guardians.
